authorization: User explicitly said: start Async E1; calibrate program CPU to about 30-40 percent first.
pairing: lane-relative matched controls; never pool rewards or margins across lanes
generation_contract: Generation 0 is frozen at preflight. Later adaptive candidates and canonical job manifests are atomically frozen before any job in that generation runs.
stopping_rule: Run all eight generations unless an infrastructure failure occurs. A candidate efficacy loss does not stop its topology direction. Infrastructure failures emit no efficacy score and do not unlock E2.
decision_boundary: E1 is an adaptive search/development tier. Its best genome is not promoted without a new explicitly authorized E2 fresh paired holdout.
runtime_selector_inputs: public state only; no opponent identity or opponent-private information
